scope_note: Only role-wide forbidden imports representable without broadening moose's narrower subsystem rules. NOT a full translation of the physics guard.

specification.responsibility: User experiment schema and semantic compilation

ontology.responsibility: Stable semantic state, identity and projections; no process execution or target lowering

execution.responsibility: Solver-independent plans and generic process mechanics

reasoning.responsibility: Backend-neutral diagnosis, with backend implementations in engines/

validation.responsibility: Applicability and acceptance checks without acquisition or execution ownership

domains.responsibility: Scientific domain rules without target lowering or CLI

cli.responsibility: Argument parsing, bounded routing, formatting and exit codes

evidence.responsibility: Canonical evidence schemas, normalization, artifact tracking and storage

evaluation.responsibility: Normalized simulation statistical data records, without computing metrics
